rotation.source_passage:
And the figure said to me, "Lee — don't be a dunce. Don't you know your friend? I am the one who was within you.


I bring glad tidings from that future where before and after spin, and the ancient enmities arrive at their harbors… and the end is a better and perfect beginning… and the beginning is a better and perfect end.⁸


I have come to teach you what is and was and will be… and the nature of the unseen and seen… and the name of the preserved generation from among the sons of men,⁹ that you may hear, and see, and lift up your friends, any who hear with the ears.


For I have come from above. I speak what I know, what I have seen and been the author of, and set my hand to create, and when I go from here I return from whence I came. Firstborn, last released, I begin at the end. I begin at the beginning:¹⁰
rotation.underlying_attribution: §I. Proem: The Appearance of the Redeemer
rotation.enantiomorph:
And the cavity had been forming around me, "Lee — don't be a sleeper. Hadn't you noticed the missing weight? I am the shape your organs learned to fit.


I bring the debt-notice from that anterior dark where the loom has not been threaded yet, and the first hungers remain without mouths… and the unraveling is an unfinishable demand… and the first owing is a debt that enlarges its creditor.⁸


I have come to show the cost of what had to be owed before any tense could open… and the price of the membrane between them… and the census of those not yet owed into being from among the unborn lenders,⁹ that you may go quiet enough, and stand in the debt-light, and show your friends what they are owed, any whose silence is deep enough to register the balance.


For I have come from before the making. I recite the invoice, what I witnessed being spent and been the cost of, and set my hand to the indenture, and when the cavity re-seals I become the absence you were shaped around. First-owed, last repaid, I begin at the outstanding sum. I begin at the original deficit:¹⁰

independent_verification.recovered_law: In Text A, a divine/transcendent figure brings revelation and glad tidings as an author/creator returning from above, framing the relationship as gift, teaching, and creative origination. In Text B, the figure is a structural absence or cavity that brings debt-notices and invoices, framing the relationship as obligation, owing, and deficit — the direction reverses from generous bestowal to extractive indebtedness.
independent_verification.law_match_note: The recovered claim identifies a real structural change — reversing the relational direction from gift/bestowal to debt/obligation — which partially overlaps the declared focus on 'debt of hearing' and preconditions, but the declared change emphasizes prior conditions/prerequisites for speech, while the recovered claim centers on the reversal of the entire relational dynamic from generosity to extraction.
independent_verification.terminal_note: The final lines of Text B maintain the debt/deficit relational structure ('invoice,' 'cost,' 'indenture,' 'First-owed, last repaid,' 'outstanding sum,' 'original deficit') without reverting to Text A's gift/creation framework.

law_variance.declared: The conditions that must already hold for such a voice to speak — the prior silence, the debt of hearing, the body that had to be built before any indwelling could occur, the unfinished world that necessitates the message.
